title: Peter Salus has died
summary: Announcement of the death of Peter Salus, a notable figure in Unix history and open source community, shared via the TUHS (The Unix Heritage Society) mailing list. Salus was known for his contributions to Unix documentation and his work at various companies including Sun Microsystems.
problem_solved: Sharing news of the passing of a Unix pioneer who contributed to the early computing and open source movements.
why_valuable: Serves as an obituary and tribute to someone who helped shape the foundation of modern computing and open source culture.
